rater_labels: rater_A and rater_B are assigned independently for every matrix with an unpublished seed; they do not identify the same clinician across matrices. Kappa is symmetric in the raters.
disclosure_rule: Full matrix only when the published kappa and the credentialed per-item aggregates already determine it up to label swap, or when it attributes no disagreement to one rater; otherwise concordant counts and unordered disagreement totals only.

reproducibility_levels.reproducible: Point estimates of every rate, loop minus zero-shot difference, preference share and margin, sign test and loop outcome count, recomputed from the published counts. Their 95% intervals are published but cannot be re-derived without item-level data.

Raw agreement and Cohen's kappa for the measures published at the `full` level, from the joint counts. For `reduced` measures only raw agreement can be rebuilt; their kappa can be checked arithmetically against the published p_e, which itself cannot be re-derived. No interval was reported for any agreement statistic.

reproducibility_levels.data: Credentialed per-item aggregates (PhysioNet), alone or with the public files
reproducibility_levels.reproducible: Every point estimate above and its admission-cluster bootstrap interval, exactly (with the case mapping), and raw agreement for every measure. Per-item aggregates do not say which clinician gave which rating, so they add nothing to Cohen's kappa: kappa comes only from the public matrices (full measures).

reproducibility_levels.data: Individual clinician ratings (internal archive only; not released)
reproducibility_levels.reproducible: Independent reproduction of kappa for `reduced` measures; per-clinician accepted-minus-rejected differences with intervals and per-clinician verifier-score correlations (the paper reports both only as ranges, which are published); per-clinician differences; the sensitivity analysis excluding a clinician's paired judgment when either arm was Unclear.

manuscript.quote: Agreement on the coding-stage composite was 0.73 (κ = 0.39); diagnosis-stage κ is deflated by the ceiling.
